text: {"question":"Which of the generalized PAge parameterizations is most strongly favored when the FAP data are included, and how does its performance compare to the other GPAge models in terms of the Bayesian evidence, AIC, and BIC?","reference_answer":"When the FAP data are added, the TGPAge-Fix model is most strongly preferred over the other GPAge variants, showing higher Bayesian evidence and lower AIC and BIC values compared to TGPAge-Free and SGPAge.","passage_1_contribution":"The abstract states that GPAge parameterizations can alleviate the Hubble tension and are preferred over ΛCDM.","passage_2_contribution":"Table VI shows that with SN+CMB+FAP data, TGPAge-Fix and TGPAge-Free are strongly preferred over SGPAge, with TGPAge-Fix performing best in ln B, ΔAIC, and ΔBIC.","joint_reason":"The claim that GPAges can resolve the tension is supported by the quantitative evidence in Table VI, which specifies that TGPAge-Fix outperforms the other models when FAP data are included.","same_quantity":true}
